result.title: DecoupAttn: Decoupled Sparse Attention for Training-Free Acceleration of Video Diffusion
result.summary: Sparse attention accelerates few-step video diffusion transformers by computing a few key blocks exactly and compensating for the rest. However, existing sparse attention still faces key challenges, including identification overhead from finding critical blocks at every denoising step, suboptimal budget allocation that sets sparsity budgets uniformly or by local metrics, and cross-step error accumulation as reused masks or clusters go stale. Observing that the errors left on skipped blocks cancel each other once every key is compensated, we propose DecoupAttn, a new paradigm of decoupled sparse attention: semantic clusters compensate every key, and exact attention corrects their error on a few blocks fixed once offline by position. To support this paradigm, we introduce Distortion Budget, a rate-distortion objective for budget allocation that places exact computation across timesteps, layers, and heads where it removes the most distortion that compensation leaves in the final latent. Built on this budget, we further propose Reassign Cache, in which each step reassigns the drifting keys to cached centroids and refreshes compensation while the budgeted blocks stay fixed. Moreover, DecoupAttn is training-free: a few calibration clips compile one plan offline, and inference runs standard block-sparse kernels with one fused compensation kernel. Our code will be released after submission.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DecoupAttn：一种免训练的稀疏注意力加速框架，用语义聚类补偿全部 key，并仅保留少量位置固定的精确块纠错；配合 Distortion Budget 在时间步、层、头间分配精确算力，以及 Reassign Cache 逐步重分配漂移的 key。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「缓存簇/掩码过期引起跨步误差累积」与「按失真在各层各步分配精确计算」的机制，可能可供核查多步 latent 推理中的状态缓存刷新、注意力稀疏结构与计算分配；但对象是视频扩散加速，迁移可行性需判读。
